scope: Retrospective internal diagnostic on previously inspected refit-target outcomes. Fix this analysis locally before generating new out-of-task predictions. This is not a new external cohort or a prospective registration.
target: Binary excess loss against the refitted anchor on archived outer test rows, using the original 3% relative AUC/accuracy and applicable 5% relative AP tolerance, with 1e-12 numerical slack.
sampling: Analyze the two proposal sources independently, keeping every unique nonempty strict support once per source and fold. Never train across sources. Hold out a whole dataset, including every fold and support. Do not use the held-out task to compute features' scaling, prevalence, hyperparameters or coefficients. Report overlap and task/fold support.
inputs: x is deleted fraction (anchor size minus retained size)/anchor size. v is the largest number of dissenting panels in a separating context divided by four. Use the width included in the deletion proposal and the associated frozen separating ballots. Do not use candidate loss, task identity, or observed class prevalence of the held-out task as predictors.
models: Both logistic models use an intercept, x, and max(x-k,0) at each fixed knot. The augmented model adds v linearly. Standardize columns to weighted mean zero and unit SD using only training tasks and their analytic weights; a constant column has scale one. Minimize weighted mean binary log loss plus lambda/2 times the squared norm of the standardized coefficients. Do not penalize the intercept. No tuning, recalibration, per-task adjustment or interaction.
weighting: Weight tasks equally, their nonempty folds equally and proposals within a fold equally, for both training and out-of-task scoring. For a metric with eligibility restrictions, average only eligible folds within each eligible task, then average eligible tasks. Retain single-outcome folds for log loss and Brier.
metrics: Primary: paired change in out-of-task binary log loss in natural units (augmented minus size). Secondary: Brier score, within-fold AUC with half-credit ties and only folds with both labels, and within-width concordance pooling same-width failing-passing pairs within each fold before fold/task aggregation. Evaluate both fitted models on exactly the same proposals/pairs. A fitted size score must tie within width. Save fold and task denominators.
intervals: For each source and metric, resample eligible held-out task summaries uniformly with replacement and average the paired augmented-minus-size differences. Report percentile 95% intervals. Fixed out-of-task predictions: intervals describe variation among the available tasks conditional on these fits; overlapping training sets are not separately resampled. Also report range of estimated mean changes after removing one task from the whole study and recomputing all remaining held-out-task fits, under exactly the same settings. Do not use this sensitivity for model selection.
limits: Folds and candidate pairs are dependent. The collections overlap and cannot be treated as independent replications. A predictive improvement on these historical offers is distinct from a change in an operational refit policy, downstream task accuracy, or computation.
